gen-gf-dynapuff-gf-epunda-slab: DynaPuff has a wire-thin sameness of line, as if every letter were cut from one sheet with a single blade. Epunda Slab, a text serif with a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, keeps a long paragraph feeling dignified and easy to follow.
gen-gf-dynapuff-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads literary and low-slung, its middle band tall and its ascenders shallow. DynaPuff is best at bold, bouncy display letters with no quill-like tapering, while Fauna One is best at settling into steady, dignified lines.
gen-gf-dynapuff-gf-glegoo: Glegoo brings big counters and wide, unclosed curves, refined in an editorial way and quite generous with its space. Glegoo handles the reading, so DynaPuff can earn its keep big and short, with bent-paperclip letters that never swell.
gen-gf-dynapuff-gf-graduate: Each DynaPuff letter stands alone with space around it, drawn with a pen-like line that never changes weight. Graduate answers with generous gaps and almost no capital-to-lowercase difference.
gen-gf-dynapuff-gf-hanuman: DynaPuff has a wire-like monoline skeleton, with every letter standing apart from its neighbors and a big lowercase. And Hanuman, a text serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, gives it a traditional, refined partner underneath.
gen-gf-dynapuff-gf-kadwa: DynaPuff's bowls stay full right to the sides, never thinning, and each letter sits alone in its own space. Kadwa, a text serif, adds editorial polish.
gen-gf-dynapuff-gf-noticia-text: DynaPuff traces a constant-width outline you could follow with a finger, each letter standing apart and bold. Noticia Text, a text serif with big visible entrances into its curves, brings a literary, dignified calm to the lines beneath.
gen-gf-dynapuff-gf-piazzolla: Chunky, playful, fixed-pen strokes. Piazzolla, a text serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals and whose e opens like a pried clasp, keeps a long paragraph refined and authoritative.
gen-gf-dynapuff-gf-pridi: Distinctive is the first word for DynaPuff, a pipe-cleaner feel in every letterform with a big lowercase. Pridi, a refined serif with small letters standing proud and generous space where curves meet stems, steadies the page below it.
gen-gf-dynapuff-gf-scope-one: Pipe-cleaner letters with stroke widths that never shift from stem to curve, each one standing alone. DynaPuff is best at bold display shapes, while Scope One is best at traditional, refined lines.
